name: Hill Dwarf
description: Dwarves with keen senses, deep intuition and remarkable resilience; gain +1 hit point per level.

name: Mountain Dwarf
description: Strong, hardy dwarves used to rugged terrain, proficient with light and medium armor.

name: Duergar
description: Underdark dwarves with advantage on saves against illusions, charm and paralysis, who can cast enlarge (3rd level) and invisibility (5th level) on themselves once per rest, but suffer in direct sunlight.

name: High Elf
description: Elves with a sharp mind who know one wizard cantrip and train with traditional elven weapons.

name: Wood Elf
description: Forest elves with a 35 ft walking speed who can hide in light natural cover such as foliage, rain, snow or mist.

name: Drow
description: Dark elves of the Underdark with 120 ft darkvision and innate spellcasting, but with a penalty in direct sunlight.

name: Eladrin
description: Feywild elves with a bonus-action 30 ft teleport once per short rest. At higher levels it gains an effect that depends on the season of their mood (autumn charms, winter frightens, spring teleports an ally, summer deals fire damage).

name: Sea Elf
description: Elves of the ocean with spear, trident, light crossbow and net training, a 30 ft swim speed, air and water breathing, and the ability to communicate with Small and Tiny sea beasts.

name: Shadar-kai
description: Shadowfell elves with necrotic resistance who can teleport as a bonus action and gain damage resistance until the start of their next turn, once per short rest.

name: Moon Elf

traits.name: No traits of its own - uses High Elf traits

description: Forgotten Realms name for a kind of high elf. The Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide covers it as setting flavor, with no separate stat block.

name: Sun Elf

traits.name: No traits of its own - uses High Elf traits

description: Forgotten Realms name for a kind of high elf, covered the same way as the moon elf, with no separate stat block.

name: Avariel
description: Winged elves with a 30 ft flying speed while wearing light or no armor and no ability score bonus. Unearthed Arcana playtest material, not a published book.

name: Grugach
description: Reclusive wild elves proficient with spear, shortbow, longbow and net, who know one druid cantrip (Wisdom) and speak Sylvan. Unearthed Arcana playtest material, not a published book.

name: Lightfoot
description: Affable, wandering halflings who can hide behind a creature at least one size larger than themselves.

name: Stout
description: Hardier halflings (said to have dwarven blood) with advantage on saves against poison and resistance to poison damage.

name: Ghostwise
description: Rare, clannish forest halflings who can speak telepathically to a creature within 30 ft.

name: Forest Gnome
description: Secretive woodland gnomes who know minor illusion and can communicate simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts.

name: Rock Gnome
description: Inventive, hardy gnomes who can build tiny clockwork devices and add double their proficiency bonus to History checks about magical, alchemical or technological items.

name: Deep Gnome
description: Svirfneblin, secretive Underdark gnomes who blend into rocky surroundings.

name: Asmodeus
description: The default tiefling bloodline: thaumaturgy, then hellish rebuke (3rd level) and darkness (5th level).

name: Baalzebul
description: Thaumaturgy, ray of sickness (3rd level) and crown of madness (5th level).

name: Dispater
description: Tieflings suited to spying and infiltration: thaumaturgy, disguise self (3rd level) and detect thoughts (5th level).

name: Fierna
description: Forceful, persuasive tieflings: friends, charm person (3rd level) and suggestion (5th level).

name: Glasya
description: Tieflings with heist-friendly magic: minor illusion, disguise self (3rd level) and invisibility (5th level).

name: Levistus
description: Cold-themed tieflings: ray of frost, armor of Agathys (3rd level) and darkness (5th level).

name: Mammon
description: Tieflings gifted at gathering and guarding wealth: mage hand, Tenser's floating disk (3rd level) and arcane lock (5th level).

name: Mephistopheles
description: Tieflings with arcane and fire magic: mage hand, burning hands (3rd level) and flame blade (5th level).

name: Zariel
description: Stronger, battle-ready tieflings: thaumaturgy, searing smite (3rd level) and branding smite (5th level).

name: Feral
description: A Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide variant for tieflings not descended from Asmodeus. Its ability scores replace the base increase, and it has a free-form appearance and three mutually exclusive trait swaps: Devil's Tongue, Hellfire or Winged.
